examples: Copy the skill you wrote in one project into three others, or into the personal skills folder every Claude login shares, after a dry run that lists its scripts.
Drop a stale copy of a skill from one project without opening a terminal; it goes to the trash, not away.
how_to: Or use the API: POST /api/v1/skills/copy is a dry run by default; a real copy needs that dry run's generation and source_digest.

Read the matrix with GET /api/v1/skills/command-center or the skills_command_center MCP tool: one row per skill, one column per place it lives, each cell marked here, differs, missing, no folder yet or shadowed.
media_exempt: the tab's screenshots are recaptured before the next version bump, not per change
name: Skill command center (API and MCP)
summary: See every local skill against every project and the personal skills folders, and copy one skill folder to other projects with a dry run, a digest check, a trash-backed replace and a per-cell remove to the trash.
surfaces: API and MCP: skills_command_center, skills_copy, skills_remove
where: API: /api/v1/skills/command-center and /api/v1/skills/copy and /api/v1/skills/remove; MCP: skills_command_center (the skills page tab was removed).
